gap_records.summary: Required candidate file for `native_godot_project` is unverified.

acceptance_requirements: A new game presents a visible, mature proportioned player in a bounded 3D space. WASD moves relative to the camera; the character turns with travel, remains on the playable surface, and stops or slides at walls.
The third-person camera follows the player, responds to mouse movement, avoids nearby walls, and switches shoulders with Tab without reversing the player's world facing.
deferred_items: The remaining R02 behaviors—jumping, sprinting, dodging, rolling, automatic step-up, and equipment attachment—remain required in later increments. Keep the full R02 review unverified until independently observed.
implied_completion: Ground movement needs enough collision geometry and camera clearance for an ordinary-input route to show movement, turning, wall contact, and shoulder switching.
mandatory_objectives: Advance PRD §3.1 and R02 with one playable ground movement and third-person camera increment.
Preserve the Godot 4.7 Compatibility target and report the full R02 gate according to actual host evidence.
task_specification.objective: Turn the bound bootstrap into a small playable Aelor movement and camera slice for the milestone_01 R02 review.

diagnosis.root_cause: The bound candidate is a Godot bootstrap scene containing only a Node, so it has no observable player movement or camera behavior. The R02 host check is unverified; there is no prior runtime verdict to classify as a failure.

stop_conditions: Stop this increment after the two listed observable conditions and their focused checks; retain the unimplemented R02 behaviors as required work.
If registered host replay or capture is unavailable, report the review as blocked or unknown rather than treating a scene load or candidate-authored state as a pass.

strategy.rationale: The candidate has no player scene yet. A bounded ground route establishes ordinary-input movement and camera evidence before adding the remaining R02 actions.

code: Check that the candidate scene and scripts import and parse in the pinned Godot runtime, with the Compatibility renderer retained.
runtime: Host replays new-game movement, wall contact, mouse rotation, and Tab switching using ordinary input; compare observed position and facing before and after each action.
Run the frozen milestone_01_r02_player_locomotion_contract review and retain its actual verdict. This slice alone does not establish a full R02 pass.
visual: Inspect separated runtime views at spawn, during forward and lateral travel, against a wall, and after each shoulder switch for model facing, camera clearance, and readable player scale.

done_when: From new game, ordinary WASD input moves the visible player relative to the current camera view through a bounded route; turning matches the model front, wall contact stops or slides, and the player neither falls through nor becomes stuck.
Mouse input changes the following third-person view; the camera stays clear of route walls, and Tab changes shoulders while the player's world facing and travel direction remain coherent.
tasks.instructions: Use PRD §3.1 and R02 as the authority. Build only the first playable ground movement and camera slice from the bound bootstrap. Inspect the local character and animation resource candidates for geometry, materials, textures, scale, forward direction, compatibility, and license before binding one; compare a bounded external option only if Developer network authority permits it. The player-character family is a continuously visible semantic singleton: use one qualified, mature-proportioned stylized low-poly source, with its actual runtime binding checked from front, rear, and shoulder views. Consult the registered Godot documentation for the movement, input, camera, and collision behavior used, then probe the result in the pinned Compatibility runtime. Keep resource provenance and any selected asset paths in the candidate handoff. The full R02 check remains broader than this increment.

research_assessment.reason: The bootstrap contains no player or camera, and catalog titles alone do not establish a model's style, scale, rig, or runtime fit. A small ordinary-input route is needed to assess collision and camera behavior.
research_assessment.target_capability: R02 ground movement and third-person camera

risk_note.summary: The qualitative R02 review is most likely to end with insufficient evidence if it sees only a loaded scene or a static frame.
risk_note.validation: Use host-owned ordinary keyboard, mouse, and Tab replay with candidate-bound state observations and separated runtime frames at spawn, wall contact, camera rotation, and each shoulder position.
risk_note.why_now: The bootstrap has no player state to replay, so this slice creates the first measurable R02 surface.
